text:
alex_support: Hey team, running into intermittent 401s on streaming after token auto-refresh for AcmeCorp. Happens ~30-45s into the stream, usually after a few chunks. Need minimal curl repro + checklist for customer to collect debug bundle. Request ID from last failure: r-9f8e7d6c.

megan_sre: Thanks Alex — can you share the exact curl you used and whether the client or our gateway did the token rotation? Also attach any proxy in front of the client.

alex_support: Client rotates tokens (short TTL worker). Customer uses an nginx reverse proxy. Minimal curl we gave them was:

```bash
curl -v --no-buffer \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <SHORT_LIVED_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=gpt-redwood-mini \
```

But they only captured partial traces. When it fails, server returns 401 and client reconnects and succeeds with new token. We need steps so they can produce a single-shot reproducible dump and include headers (x-request-id).

devon_clientlib: Quick repro playbook I use locally:

```bash
# 1) generate short token (placeholder)
TOKEN="<EXPIRING_TOKEN>"
# 2) run curl with trace and raw output to capture framing
curl --no-buffer -v --raw --trace-ascii curl-trace.txt \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "X-Client-Id: acmecorp-test" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=gpt-redwood-mini
```

Add `--compressed` if the client uses gzip. Also capture client logs around token rotate and nginx access/error logs for the same timeframe.

megan_sre: Add these headers to the request so we can map traces server-side: `X-Request-Id: <random>` and `X-Trace-Id: <random>`. Ask customer to `--trace-ascii out.txt` and attach that file plus nginx access.log lines for the request-id.

infra_bot: Reminder: include the following checklist in the bundle:
- curl-trace.txt (from --trace-ascii)
- client stdout/stderr around token rotate window (±60s)
- nginx access.log & error.log entries for the request-id
- value for `x-request-id` header used in the test
- exact time (UTC) of test run 
- minimal repro curl command used (paste exact)
- whether connection used HTTP/2 or HTTP/1.1

priya_support: Also ask them to run one variant that forces token refresh while connection is open: get new token and send new Authorization header mid-stream (if their client supports). If they can't, have them rotate token server-side but keep the old token valid for 5s to replicate race.

alex_support: Great checklists — I'll send these to the customer. One more: what server headers should we look for to confirm gateway rejected vs auth-service?

devon_clientlib: Look for `WWW-Authenticate` body + 401 from gateway for immediate reject. If auth-service triggers, gateway usually returns 502/504 or 401 with `x-auth-reason` header (we log `x-auth-decision`). Capture response headers in curl trace.

megan_sre: Perfect. If they attach the bundle, I'll correlate `r-9f8e7d6c` with ingress logs and confirm whether token rotated or proxy dropped the header.

alex_support: Sending playbook now to customer, will update here when bundle lands. :thumbsup:
